setup: Write the curve as a level set \(F(x, y) = x^{2} + y^{2} - [[k]] = 0\); the implicit function theorem gives \(dy/dx = -F_x/F_y\) wherever \(F_y \ne 0\).

steps.say: At \(([[x]], [[y]])\): \(F_x = [[fx]]\) and \(F_y = [[fy]]\), and \(F_y \ne 0\), so \(y\) is a function of \(x\) there.

answer: The slope of the curve at \(([[x]], [[y]])\) is [[slope]].
